name: PR list FINDINGS chips open the PR pre-filtered to that severity
description: From the PR list, click the CRITICAL chip in PR #482's FINDINGS column and confirm it lands on the PR detail page with both ?tab=findings and ?severity=critical already applied, showing the seeded CRITICAL finding. This is the cross-page contract: the list rolls up the latest review of each agent (server side, GET /repos/:id/pulls) and the detail page recomputes the same tally client-side, so a mismatch in either formula shows up here. The chip is a button nested inside the row, which navigates on its own click — this flow also guards the stopPropagation that keeps the row handler from overwriting the filtered URL. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
